meta.title: Portfolio — Elizaveta Sashenkova
meta.description: Portfolio of Elizaveta Sashenkova — creative designer & developer. Branding, web, interactive experiences, WebGL, 3D, and motion.

about.intro: By training, I am a master artist — sculpture, ceramics, painting, drawing, stained glass. After school I worked with photography for a while and gradually moved into digital. I work in branding, web, and development. I care about the feeling of interaction, so I am drawn to interactive experiences where something responds, moves, and breathes. I often test concepts directly in code. I take on different kinds of projects — the main thing is that they have energy and character.
about.outro: Thanks for stopping by! Whether it is branding, an interactive 3D project, a sharp modern website, or something more experimental, please feel free to reach out. I am always happy to chat and see how I can help.

stop-gallery.title: Stop Gallery
stop-gallery.description: A WebGL sticker gallery that works as a digital art space.
stop-gallery.pageDescription: Stop Gallery was created as part of Stop&Glow — a festival case for an art therapy lamp designed for remote workers and office creative teams to maintain balance between work and rest. An important part of the project is the idea of customizing the lamp with magnetic stickers created in collaboration with creative authors.

koziri.title: Koziri
koziri.description: An interactive landing concept for a cover band with a built-in audio player.
koziri.pageDescription: The task was to create a landing page for a cover band built around the concept of playing cards. The goal was to avoid the obvious visual clichés and present an interactive solution. A competition entry for Taptop.

mif.title: Myth
mif.description: An interactive web concept for the MIF section "Myths from A to Z".
mif.pageDescription: A project for a design battle by Perasperadastra: two designers, one theme, a couple of hours, then voting. The task was to present my own solution for redesigning the MIF publishing house website section "Myths from A to Z".

zus-studio.title: ZUS
zus-studio.description: Homepage implementation for a branding and web development studio.
zus-studio.pageDescription: Coded implementation of the homepage for the ZUS design studio. Same-day delivery: build, deploy to hosting, transfer the domain. The site already existed, but it was outdated and no longer reflected the studio's current positioning.

murch.title: Murch
murch.description: 3D keychains for print as merch for Dprofile Fest 2025.
murch.pageDescription: A collaborative merch project with a team of eight designers. Created for Dprofile Fest 2025 to exchange with other designers while networking. The project was about easy interaction with the community — driven not by fear, but by love.

max.title: MAX
max.description: Branding for a new residential complex in Tyumen.
max.pageDescription: Branding for a new residential complex in Tyumen. A development created through the collaboration of two leading developers — Tochno and Tvorchestvo. The project was developed for a Dprofile competition.

role.lead: My role: Concept, 3D, UI/UX, development and WebGL interface implementation — solo project.
role.body: The gallery is a WebGL space built with Three.js, where the lamp becomes a canvas: magnetic stickers from solo creators and studios are placed directly on the 3D object. Visitors move through the interactive space, explore stickers by different authors on the art object, and can imagine their own work in the same format. The project rethinks the digital gallery format by turning a functional object into an exhibition space.

role.lead: My role: Concept, logo design, UI, first-screen prototype — competition project
role.body: The logo consists of two parts — one of which comes alive on the site and becomes the cursor on the first scroll down. The cards are styled like playing cards spread across a table. The built-in audio player is the key solution so that entering the site immediately engages visitors with the band's repertoire.

elements.alt: Koziri interface elements: audio player and logo

role.lead: My role: Concept, UI, 3D elements, interaction design — design battle.
role.body: The original site page is full of color, with emphasis on book covers. In my concept I went in the opposite direction — toward minimal detail and away from showing book covers. The concept uses interactive 3D elements and linear illustrations. I was interested in testing whether a section about books could work without putting the books themselves in focus, shifting attention to their characters instead.

elements.alt: Myth character illustrations: merman and Thoth

role.lead: My role: Front-end development from a finished layout — studio project.
role.body: Initially I worked with the creative director at ZUS on a full website based on my prototype. When deadlines tightened, the team chose a faster route. I built and launched the final one-page site based on the art director's homepage layout.

role.lead: My role: 3D keychain modeling, preparing models for print — team project.
role.body: Two out of three keychain designs were produced, based on illustrations by the team. One design did not perform as expected in print. So we abandoned it during production. The keychains aroused great interest at the festival.

role.lead: My role: Concept, motion, illustration — competition project
role.body: The MAX district is built for maximalists — for those who want more, live brightly, and get the most out of life. This became the basis for the slogan "Light up life to the MAX" and the spark metaphor: from a small spark comes a firework of sensations.
